description: Change of use from Class B8 (Storage and Distribution) to Mixed use MOT and Vehicle Repair (Use Class Sui Generis) and Metal Fabrication Unit (Use Class B2), associated parking, Installation of shutters in the side elevations; a new vehicle crossover
decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal" style="">The development hereby permitted shall be carried out and thereafter
operated in accordance with the details and fire safety measures set out within
the approved Fire Safety Statement (Ref: Unit 2 Brember Road, South Harrow,
Harrow, HA2 8AX).<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 11pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of
three years from the date of this permission.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The development hereby permitted shall be carried out and the use
thereafter operated in accordance with the following approved plans and
documents, except where otherwise required by conditions attached to this
permission</p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><!--[if !supportLists]--><span lang="EN-US" style="">-<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><!--[endif]--><span lang="EN-US" style="">Site

Safety Statement (Ref Unit 2 Brember Road, South Harrow, Harrow, HA2 8AX)<o:p></o:p></span></p><p>













</p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><!--[if !supportLists]--><span lang="EN-US" style="">-<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><!--[endif]--><span lang="EN-US" style="">Transport
Statement prepared by Fotom Consulting (Ref FC/2026/P000209 dated August 2026)<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">No use of the premises for the MOT testing, vehicle repair and metal
fabrication activities hereby permitted shall commence until the proposed
vehicular accesses onto Brember Road, including any necessary alterations to
the existing public highway, have been completed in accordance with details
submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">&nbsp;</p><p>



</p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The details shall include the proposed vehicle crossovers, dropped kerbs
and any necessary alterations to the existing marked on-street parking bays.</p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p><br></o:p></font></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p><span style="font-size: 14px;">The approved access arrangements shall thereafter be retained and maintained for the lifetime of the development.</span></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Prior to the first use of the development hereby permitted, details of
secure, enclosed and accessible cycle storage facilities for a minimum of two
bicycles shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning
Authority. The approved facilities shall be installed prior to the first use of
the development and thereafter retained and maintained for the lifetime of the development.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="">Prior to the first use of the development hereby permitted, details of
secure, enclosed and suitably sized refuse and recycling storage facilities,
together with a suitably scoped Waste Management Plan, shall be submitted to
and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall
include the location, design and capacity of the storage facilities,
anticipated waste streams arising from the proposed uses, and arrangements for
waste segregation, management and collection.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="">&nbsp;</p><p>



</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="">The approved refuse and recycling storage facilities shall be installed
prior to the first use of the development and thereafter retained and
maintained, with waste managed in accordance with the approved Waste Management
Plan for the lifetime of the development.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 11pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">Prior to the installation of the proposed roller shutter doors, details
of their design, type, style, materials, colour and finish, together with
details of the proposed making good of the surrounding brickwork and any
associated external finishes, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by
the Local Planning Authority.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">&nbsp;</p><p>



</p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
and thereafter retained.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The development hereby permitted shall be operated in accordance with the
noise mitigation measures set out within the submitted Noise Impact Assessment
prepared by Completely Sound Ltd (Ref: 1205.0426.00, dated 19 May 2026).<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">&nbsp;</p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">In particular:<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">&nbsp;</p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><!--[if !supportLists]--><span lang="EN-US" style="">a)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><!--[endif]--><span lang="EN-US" style="">All
cutting, grinding and other noisy metal fabrication activities shall be
undertaken within the building, away from the north-facing opening where
reasonably practicable, with no such activities undertaken externally.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span lang="EN-US" style="">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><!--[if !supportLists]-->b)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]--><span lang="EN-US" style="">The
north-facing workshop door/shutter shall remain closed during cutting and
grinding activities, where practicable.</span><o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraph"><span lang="EN-US" style="">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><!--[if !supportLists]-->c)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]--><span lang="EN-US" style="">No
fixed external plant or machinery shall be installed unless an acoustic
assessment has first been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local
Planning Authority, together with any necessary mitigation measures.</span><o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraph"><span lang="EN-US" style="">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><!--[if !supportLists]-->d)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]--><span lang="EN-US" style="">Any
reversing alarms used in connection with the development shall be of a
broadband/white-noise type rather than tonal alarms.</span><o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraph"><span lang="EN-US" style="">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><!--[if !supportLists]-->e)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]--><span lang="EN-US" style="">All
deliveries, loading and unloading, and forklift movements shall take place only
during the permitted operational hours.</span><o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraph"><span lang="EN-US" style="">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><!--[if !supportLists]-->f)<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]--><span lang="EN-US" style="">A
record of noise complaints received in connection with the permitted use,
together with any investigation and remedial action undertaken, shall be
maintained by the operator and made available to the Local Planning Authority
upon reasonable request.</span><o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">&nbsp;</p><p class="MsoListParagraph">































</p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The approved noise mitigation measures shall be implemented from the
first use of the development and thereafter maintained and complied with for
the lifetime of the development.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></p>
